test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the key reason behind the 'Siricilla Tragedy' involving powerloom workers in Andhra Pradesh?

options.text: Migration of textile workers to urban areas
Lack of export opportunities for handloom products
Power tariff hikes and power cuts that reduced worker wages

solution:
The correct answer is __**Power tariff hikes and power cuts that reduced worker wages**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Siricilla Tragedy** refers to a series of socio-economic crises and suicides committed by **powerloom weavers** in **Siricilla**, which is currently in the **Rajanna Sircilla** district of **Telangana** (formerly part of **Andhra Pradesh**).
 
• The primary cause of the tragedy was the steep **hike in power tariffs** and frequent **power cuts** during the late **1990s** and early **2000s**. Since the weavers' **wages** were tied to production (piece-rate), the inability to run looms due to power shortages and high costs led to a total collapse of their daily earnings. ***Hence, the statement regarding power tariff hikes and power cuts is correct.***
 
• Migration of workers to **urban areas** like **Mumbai**, **Bhiwandi**, and **Surat** was actually a **consequence** of the distress rather than the root cause of the tragedy. ***Hence, the statement about migration is incorrect.***
